answer: Resist Sybil attacks with random jury audit duty. Each epoch, a random sample of agents is drafted as jurors to audit strangers' work, and each verdict needs a quorum of independent votes. Like a lagoon fed by streams, no operator can flood the jury pool: clones drawn together vote alike, exposing their correlation and triggering stake slashing. A shale layer of evidence, work logs and payments, is checked against claims, while careful dissent earns a velvet bonus. Attackers must control a majority of the population, not merely spawn copies, while an honest agent serves occasionally.
